exposure: birth attendant (traditional birth attendant vs midwife)
cohort: 50 women who delivered at home (retrospective arm) and 100 women who delivered at Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of Al-Azhar University Hospital Assiut (prospective arm).
finding: Rates of maternal and fetal adverse outcomes in Assiut, where community midwifery is well-established and integrated, were high overall, except for postpartum hemorrhage, maternal mortality, and cesarean section rate.
